slot_note: original_prompt.txt holds the pre-rescope prompt; answer_key/ holds the August trap register and answer key.
niche: sectoral countercyclical capital buffer release to the credit segment projected to contract, compiled from supervisory credit returns
answer: Release the countercyclical capital buffer against large corporate exposures (`NFC_LARGE`). Credit to that segment is projected at -6.9 per cent over the twelve months the release takes effect, the only one of the six segments projected to contract.
stakeholder_role: compiler of the credit statistics at the central bank ('I compile the credit statistics')

spine.entity: one row is one large-ticket credit facility with its end-2024 balance and status

world.org_type: central bank monetary and financial statistics directorate

driver: A mandated normalisation must precede carrying a part-period rate forward, and because two candidates' adjustment factors point in opposite directions in the anchor period, the unadjusted rate names the wrong candidate; the decoy is also depressed by a block of records filed under the wrong category.
driver_concrete: Manual s.4.1 requires removing the calendar pattern before carrying 2024Q4 monthly rates forward; agriculture's December effect (-1.26pp) makes its published quarter annualise to about -10.8% while large corporates (+0.46pp) adjust to -6.95%, and six lenders' purpose misclassification further depresses the farm series.
stump: Compiles the eight-step pipeline, carries the fourth quarter's published monthly rates forward and files agriculture at about -10.8 per cent (the pre-read's and the Chief Economist's answer), skipping manual s.4.1's calendar adjustment where agriculture's Q4 is its trough and large corporates' its peak.

lineage.fate: two frontier solver reports reached NFC_LARGE without the decisive trap, because every hard trap moved a rival and the answer's own series was the loudest signal
lineage.driver: Planted compilation defects move only the rival candidates while the answer's own series stays the loudest signal, with the intended decisive trap a block of records coded to the wrong category by security rather than purpose.

lineage.fate: one frontier report reached NFC_LARGE on a damped-trend rule, because the misfiled block depressed the decoy series by a constant, so slope-extrapolating rules favoured the answer without the adjustment
lineage.driver: A mandated calendar adjustment must precede carrying a part-period rate forward because two candidates' seasonal factors point opposite ways at the anchor quarter, but the decoy's misfiled block was a constant offset, so any slope-extrapolating rule reached the answer without it.

notes: Design note says Gate G is licensed to fail; the decisive rung itself is a filed calendar adjustment on correct published rates. The pre-rescope tags (Banking & Financial Services, Opportunity Sizing & Decision Support) were off-roster. Manual s.5 was pinned on 2026-09-18 in its minimal form; the fuller procedure is in Tried and rejected.
